tagline: A small, creative waterfront quarter between Kabataş and Karaköy — home to İstanbul Modern, waterfront parks, and one of the city's most scenic coastal walks.

items.name: İstanbul Modern Café
items.description: The café inside Turkey's premier modern art museum with stunning Bosphorus terrace views. Excellent for a cultured afternoon break.

items.name: İstanbul Modern
items.description: Turkey's foremost modern and contemporary art museum in a spectacular waterfront building. World-class rotating exhibitions and a permanent collection.
items.tip: Check the current exhibitions before visiting — the programme is consistently strong. The museum shop is excellent for design-oriented gifts.

items.name: Fındıklı Sahil Yürüyüşü
items.description: A beautiful coastal walk along the Bosphorus from Fındıklı to Kabataş or Karaköy. The waterfront park is well maintained and rarely crowded.

tips: Fındıklı is on the T1 tram line — one stop from Kabataş and two from Karaköy.
İstanbul Modern is the main reason to come — it's one of Istanbul's finest cultural institutions.
The coastal park here is far less crowded than Karaköy's waterfront. Good for an evening walk.
Best combined with Karaköy (10-min walk) for a full afternoon of art, coffee, and waterfront views.
